2608.04746.title: Caching for the Future: Scrub Jay Episodic Memory Principles for Agent Memory Systems
2608.04746.paper_summary: LLM agents that persist across sessions accumulate stored memories whose validity varies enormously by content type, yet existing memory architectures treat all memories as equally persistent and systematically contaminate retrieved context with outdated facts. We show that per-memory, type-conditioned temporal decay, a property of western scrub jay episodic memory, can be operationalized as an auto-classified coefficient $π_i$ in an external LLM-agent memory store, yielding ScrubJay-MEM: each memory is encoded as a jointly-bound What--Where--When tuple with an estimated perishability $π_i$ and utility horizon $τ_i$, retrieved by query-adaptive scoring, and revised retroactively at $O(1)$ LLM calls per update. We introduce the Temporal Generalization Test (TGT), a benchmark with held-out retention intervals and a Generalization Gap (GenGap) metric. On TGT, ScrubJay-MEM is the only retrieval-based system with substantially positive GenGap ($+0.108$); on MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k it improves F1 by $+2.66$ over Mem0 and $+3.09$ over Qwen3-Embedding-4B under a llm backbone. A decay ablation collapses GenGap by $5.7\times$, establishing type-conditioned decay as necessary for the result. Gains narrow under stronger backbones and reverse on fact-consolidation tasks, scoping the contribution to temporal reasoning over perishable facts.
2608.04746.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理在會話中持續存在，累積的儲存記憶其有效性因內容類型而異，但現有的記憶架構將所有記憶視為同等持久，並系統性地用過時的事實污染檢索的上下文。我們展示了每個記憶的類型條件時間衰減，這是西部灌木藍鵲情節記憶的一個特性，可以在外部 LLM 代理記憶存儲中作為自動分類係數 $π_i$ 實現，產生 ScrubJay-MEM：每個記憶被編碼為一個聯合綁定的 What--Where--When 元組，並具有估計的易逝性 $π_i$ 和效用範圍 $τ_i$，通過查詢自適應評分檢索，並在每次更新時以 $O(1)$ 的 LLM 調用進行回溯修訂。我們引入了時間概化測試 (TGT)，這是一個具有保留間隔的基準和一個概化差距 (GenGap) 指標。在 TGT 上，ScrubJay-MEM 是唯一一個具有顯著正 GenGap ($+0.108$) 的基於檢索的系統；在 MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k 上，它在 llm 基礎上改善了 F1，較 Mem0 增加了 $+2.66$，較 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 增加了 $+3.09$。衰減消融使 GenGap 降低了 $5.7\times$，確立了類型條件衰減對結果的必要性。在更強的基礎上，增益縮小，並在事實整合任務上反轉，範圍限定了對易逝事實的時間推理的貢獻。
